title: REQ · Tests are proven to use the actual store module, not a mock
summary: A guard test shows the imported store is the real zustand store and is not mocked
description: Context: the sub-goal requires confirming the tests import the actual store rather than a mock. Desired behavior: a test asserts vi.isMockFunction(useUiStore) is false, the module namespace exports useUiStore, and the source file of the suite contains no vi.mock call for the store. Expected result: replacing the store with a mock makes the guard test fail. Why: guarantees the unit tests exercise production code.
acceptance_criteria: Given the imported useUiStore, when vi.isMockFunction is called on it and on each action, then every result is false.
Given the test file source read from disk, when searched for vi.mock, then no occurrence exists.
Given the module namespace imported from ../src/store/uiStore, when its keys are read, then useUiStore is exported.

in_scope: Guard assertions that the real module is used

technical_constraints: Read the test file with node:fs readFileSync of import.meta.url path; no network
